reason: I already shop on my way home from work, and with no car at home I can't easily get to a pickup point either. Sending a list before 2 p.m. every day is a hassle, and I can't tell what I'd actually pay for the items.
objection: I have to plan my list before 2 p.m. while I'm at work, then collect it between 6 and 8, and I have no car. For $2 a bag I'm not sure I save anything on a small shop.
would_change_my_mind: A later order cutoff, such as 5 p.m., and a pickup point I can walk to, plus proof that the baskets come out clearly cheaper than my usual shop.
